'''Elis' Gan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]], who served in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the commandant of [[Thaereian Security Facility Number 12]], a security facility in [[Gadrin]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
